Landry's Needham Women's/Non-Binary MTB Ride

Westwood, MA

Women / trans / femmeNo-drop

Landry's Needham Women's/Non-Binary MTB Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Westwood, MA. It meets every Tuesday, meet 5:45 pm, roll 6:00 pm, weather permitting, starting at Hale Reservation, Cat Rock Field lot. Pace: 6–8 mph, intermediate singletrack, regroups.

About the Landry's Needham Women's/Non-Binary MTB Ride group ride

A weekly trail ride for women and gender-expansive riders at Hale, run by Landry's Needham with SE MA NEMBA. Intermediate level: rocks, roots, ninety minutes of steady riding with regroups. Supportive and no-drop. Location can change; check the page weekly.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
